title: 第六章 值夜
slug: 盛唐风华全本免费-盛唐风华最新章节列表
content_zh:
这些庄客都是徐家闾带出来的，爷爷也教传过一些武艺，就为了保家护村。
但庄客毕竟是庄客，学了点本事也就是老实种地。才上路的时候，比之意气风发，看似天不怕地不怕的宋宝那群侠少，庄客们有些畏缩。
但是十几天下来，于途除了辛苦更没碰上其他事情之后。这些侠少们耐不得餐风饮露有些委顿下来，庄客们不仅耐得辛劳，还给磨砺出一点胆气来了。现下围坐篝火，啃着干粮也是笑声不断。
也不知道真遇到敌人会不会给打回原形。
说实在的徐乐自己也是第一次走远门，徐乐从来没有感到一丝惶恐畏惧。胸中所有的，全是跃跃欲试。天地越是广阔，前路越是莫测，徐乐只觉得自己越是有兴味。
这般少年勇气，只能说是天生。
宋宝几名侠少，坐在不远处，对着这里指指点点说笑。有人目光只是在自己座骑上流连。然后几个人也不布置夜中轮班警戒，扯过毛毡，寻一个避风处倒头就睡。
这还真是不把自己放在眼里啊，爷爷庇护下才有的那么一个乐郎君名头，真的是镇不住人！
看庄客们一个个面上都露出了不忿的模样，徐乐笑着摆手：“都去歇息吧，一路上大家都辛苦了，上半夜韩约，下半夜就是我值夜。大家养足精神，明日多走一点，早点出这见鬼的山！”
庄客们笑着摇头：“上半夜是韩约这犟牛，下半夜咱们上就是，哪里用得着乐郎君辛苦？”
庄户汉子，没那么多弯弯绕的肠子，几句话就算说定。再加上一路下来，实在行得乏了。就着火堆喝了热汤吃过干粮，倦意简直是已经慎到了骨头里。
庄客们互相道了乏，再瞅瞅宋宝那几名侠少转瞬间就有人已经鼾声大作，一个个扯过毡子，也纷纷寻了避风处，倒头就睡。
篝火噼啪响动，而在火堆旁还清醒着的人，就是一坐一立的韩约徐乐两人而已。
寒风呼啸，松涛阵阵，头顶银河经天。
徐乐站起身来，扫视了黑沉沉的周遭一眼，嘴角上扬，似笑非笑。对韩约轻声道：“宋宝铁飞燕名气好大，却瞧不上我，不听招呼。今夜他是指望不上了，万一有事，我们俩并肩上罢。”
韩约绷紧了脸：“真的有事？”
徐乐摊手：“我哪里知道？只是听见了枯枝被踩断的声音，感觉有些不对罢了。爷爷教的这些本事，我又没验过，谁知道这感觉准还是不准？”
韩约只是摇头，压低了声音：“乐郎君，宋宝不知道你的本事，我从小一样和你一起在老太公手里磨出来的，知道乐郎君你厉害……但是今夜遇事，你护着乡亲们，我一个人上。”
徐乐一笑：“你也瞧不起我？”
韩约认真的看着徐乐：“我娘交代了，一路上不能让乐郎君你冒险。我们韩家当年都是在老爷子手里救下来的。乐郎君你伤了根汗毛，就是我们韩家对不起老太公。”

韩约咧嘴一笑：“……你知道我听老娘的话，乐郎君你就别让我为难了。”
徐乐回望韩约，比起徐乐僻处乡里，却天生一副世家子弟气度。韩约就是最朴实的边地男儿模样，粗眉大眼，结实诚朴。虽然才二十一二岁的年纪，却已经厚重得如一座山也似。
自己打小和韩约一起长大，这韩约就如自己的影子一般，这么些年来，从来未曾离开左右。自己叛逆时候和侠少厮混，但有不开眼的家伙挑衅，韩约就能如疯虎一般冲上。自家这乐郎君的名声，小半靠自己豪爽开朗，对了那些侠少的脾气。小半是仗着当年爷爷的威名，剩下小半，就是靠着这韩约打出来的！
现在爷爷倒下，遮天巨树不在。可总有这韩约站在自己身后。
迎着韩约诚恳的目光，徐乐终于拍拍他肩膀：“我去睡觉，下半夜我来换你。”
韩约咧嘴一笑：“乐郎君，太公从来说我牛一般的精神气力，一夜我都包了。累不坏我。”
徐乐摇摇头，心下有点无语。十几年来，韩约说是自己跟班，其实就是爷爷的耳目，到哪儿都盯着自己，现下好容易出来一趟，韩约还是一副要把什么都包了的模样。
不过也懒得和这头犟牛争执，自己到时候爬起来，这韩约还能逼自己睡回去不成？
回转到篝火边，庄客们早就给徐乐留了一个最好的位置，离火堆不远不近，一块大石在后遮住了风，地面也给平整过了。一层毛毡垫一层毛毡盖，都还用火烘过了，躺上去整个身子都暖和了起来。

content_en:
These bankers were all brought out by the Xu family, and my grandfather also taught some martial arts, just to protect the family and the village.
But a banker is a banker after all, and if he has learned some skills, he will just farm the land honestly. When they first set out on the road, there were fewer heroes than the high-spirited and seemingly fearless Song Bao, and the bankers were a little intimidated.
But after more than ten days, Yu Tu encountered nothing but hard work. These young knights couldn't bear the wind and the dew and were a little tired. The dealers not only endured the hard work, but also gained some courage. Now we are sitting around the campfire, eating dry food and laughing constantly.
I don’t know if I will be able to return to my original form if I really encounter an enemy.
To be honest, this was also the first time for Xu Le to go far away. Xu Le never felt a trace of fear. Everything in my chest is eager to try. The broader the world, the more unpredictable the road ahead, and Xu Le only felt that he was more interested.
Such youthful courage can only be said to be natural.
Song Bao and several young knights were sitting not far away, pointing and laughing at this place. Some people's eyes just linger on their own horses. Then a few people did not arrange a night shift watch, pulled over the felt, found a sheltered place and fell asleep.
You really don't take yourself seriously. A name like Le Langjun that you only got under the protection of your grandpa really can't control people!
Seeing the dissatisfaction on the faces of all the dealers, Xu Le smiled and waved his hands: "Let's all go and have a rest. We have all worked hard along the way. In the first half of the night, Han Yue will be on duty, and in the second half of the night, I will be on duty. Everyone, keep your spirits up, walk more tomorrow, and get out of this damn mountain as soon as possible!"
The dealers smiled and shook their heads: "In the first half of the night, Han Yue is the stubborn one, and in the second half of the night we will go up, so why does Lelangjun need to work so hard?"
A banker's man doesn't have so many winding intestines, so a few words can settle the matter. In addition, walking all the way down was really exhausting. I drank hot soup and ate dry food by the fire, and my tiredness was already deep in my bones.
The bankers said goodbye to each other, and then looked at Song Bao and the knights. In an instant, some of them were snoring loudly. They pulled the felt away one by one, looked for shelter from the wind, and fell asleep.
The bonfire was crackling, but the only people still awake beside the fire were Han Yue and Xu Le, who were sitting and standing.
The cold wind is howling, the pine waves are blowing, and the Milky Way is in the sky above our heads.
Xu Le stood up, glanced at the dark surroundings, and raised the corners of his mouth, half-smiling. He whispered to Han Yue: "Song Bao Tie Feiyan is so famous, but he looks down on me and doesn't listen to greetings. I can't count on him tonight. If anything happens, let's go together."
Han Yue's face tightened: "Is something really wrong?"
Xu Le spread his hands: "How do I know? I just heard the sound of dead branches being trampled and felt something was wrong. I haven't tested the skills my grandpa taught me. Who knows whether this feeling is accurate or not?"
Han Yue just shook his head and lowered his voice: "Lelangjun, Song Bao doesn't know what you are capable of. I was trained with you in the hands of the old lady when I was a child. I know you are great, Lelangjun... But tonight if something happens, you will protect the villagers, and I will go alone."
Xu Le smiled: "You look down on me too?"
Han Yue looked at Xu Le seriously: "My mother told me that we can't let you, Mr. Lelang, take risks along the way. Our Han family was saved by the old man back then. Mr. Lelang, you hurt a hair, because our Han family is sorry for the old lady."
Han Yue grinned: "...You know I listen to my mother, please don't make things difficult for me, Mr. Lelang."
Xu Le looked back at Han Yue. Compared with Xu Le who lived in a remote village, he had the bearing of a child of aristocratic family. Han Yue looks like the simplest border man, with thick eyebrows and big eyes, strong and honest. Although he is only twenty-one or twelve years old, he is already as thick as a mountain.
I have grown up with Han Yue since I was a child. Han Yue is like my shadow. Over the years, I have never left my side. When I was rebellious, I hung out with Young Master Xia, but they couldn't get along.If an eye-catching guy provokes him, Han Yue will rush forward like a mad tiger. My family's reputation as Le Langjun is largely due to my own boldness and cheerfulness, and the temper of those young heroes. Half of them relied on my grandfather's reputation back then, and the remaining half relied on Han Yue!
Now that grandpa has fallen, the giant tree that covers the sky is no longer there. But there is always Han Yue standing behind him.
Facing Han Yue's sincere eyes, Xu Le finally patted him on the shoulder: "I'm going to bed, and I'll replace you in the middle of the night."
Han Yue grinned: "Lelangjun, Grandpa has always said that my mental strength is as strong as an ox, and I have it all in one night. I am not tired."
Xu Le shook his head, feeling a little speechless. For more than ten years, Han Yue said he was his follower, but in fact he was his grandfather's eyes and ears, watching him everywhere. Now that he finally came out, Han Yue still looked like he had everything covered.
But he was too lazy to argue with this stubborn cow. When he got up, could Han Yue force himself to go back to sleep?
Returning to the bonfire, the bankers had already reserved the best position for Xu Le, not far or near the fire. A big stone was behind to block the wind, and the ground was leveled. There is a layer of felt on top and a layer of felt cover, all of which have been heated by fire. When you lie on it, your whole body will feel warm.
